#include <iostream>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);

    std::queue<char> q;
    for (char c : s) {
        q.push(c);
    }

    int insert = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        char current = q.front();
        q.pop();
        int runLength = 1;

        while (!q.empty() && q.front() == current) {
            q.pop();
            runLength++;
        }

        if (runLength % 2 == 0) {
            insert++;
        }
    }

    std::cout << insert << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
